checks.check: Actual settings and empty preview use the shared owner shell in light/dark at 360/390/430/768/1440; text/image states preserve their values. Keyboard opens the preview and returns focus to its exact entry. Short 390×500 and 1440×600 keep the action footer reachable.

limitations: Only the runner’s disposable production runtime and database are changed. The manual preview and its data are untouched.
Held or lost fetch responses are real server responses; successful rules, task IDs and results are never fabricated.
Cancellation tests verify actual DELETE settlement and recovery. The existing media-tools integration suite verifies encoder shutdown while work is active.
Physical touch, soft keyboard and nonzero device safe areas are outside the current acceptance scope.
